summary: The menu (as of 2026-11-10, 46 names) is clean overall: every name has fscore_computable 9, and only GRMN and ONC carry a pre-computed flag (amended filings). The strongest names combine high in-sector gross profitability with cash flow well above earnings: VRSN, CARG and FTDR lead, then TPR, IDXX and DPZ. Accrual concerns are DORM (CFO about half of net income), GRMN and MLI (CFO slightly below NI). Stale fiscal years affect CLX (FY ended 2025-06-30), TTEK, SMG, BLBD and SBH. No lesson in learning.json names the Fundamentals Analyst and I have no graded calls. I still followed L3's label caveat because it bears directly on my sector-label check.
